Quick Answer for Sourcing

Selecting the right coffee packaging requires a one-way degassing valve for freshness, high-barrier material structures (like MOPP/VMPET/PE or Kraft/AL/PE), and low MOQ options for specialty roasters. BestPackFactory supports custom sizes from 250g to 1kg with MOQ 500 PCS.

Key Buyer Checklist

  • Verify MOQ and material specifications.
  • Confirm dieline and artwork requirements.
  • Request lead time for production and shipping.
  • Validate barrier properties (for flexible packaging).

Barrier and seal verification method

Method for Custom Coffee Bags Buying Guide: Materials, Valves & MOQ: Specify the final laminate, specimen count, conditioning, temperature and humidity, test method, equipment, units and acceptance limits before comparing barrier or seal results.

  • ISO 2528:2017 specifies a gravimetric method for water-vapour transmission rate and states important sensitivity and material limits for that method.
  • ASTM F88/F88M-23 measures flexible-barrier seal strength and requires the support technique to remain consistent within a test series.

Evidence limit: A material name or generic target is not a batch result. Buyers should require a report for the final printed laminate that identifies the method, conditions, specimen preparation, results and acceptance limit.

What the Spec Means for Buyers

Materials and valves are the two parameters that decide coffee freshness. Factory-standard structures are MOPP 20µm / VMPET 12µm / PE 80µm (economy metalized), PET 12µm / AL 7µm / PE 80µm (full foil), and Kraft 80gsm / VMPET 12µm / PE 70µm (kraft look). Barrier targets are OTR ≤ 0.8 cc/m²·day and WVTR ≤ 0.8 g/m²·day. The one-way degassing valve is Ø9–12 mm and placed 35–55 mm below the top seal; the press-to-close zipper is 6–8 mm, with a powder-proof zipper available for ground coffee. Seal strength is verified at ≥ 35 N / 15 mm and each batch passes a vacuum leak test, valve airflow test and 1.0 m filled drop test.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the difference between VMPET and AL structures for coffee?

VMPET (metalized) gives a cost-efficient oxygen barrier, while a full PET / AL / PE foil structure gives the highest barrier at slightly higher cost; both meet OTR ≤ 0.8 cc/m²·day.

Which tests validate a coffee bag before shipment?

Standard validation is a vacuum leak test, valve airflow test and a filled drop test at 1.0 m, plus seal strength at ≥ 35 N / 15 mm.
